infoCards.title: HOPE Scholarship
infoCards.text: HOPE uses test scores or your GPA, not specific classes: an ACT of 21 or SAT of 1060, or an overall 3.0 GPA figured with the state's Uniform Grading Policy (which adds points for honors, AP and similar classes). ACT superscores aren't accepted.

infoCards.title: General Assembly Merit Scholarship
infoCards.text: This award adds to HOPE for students with a 3.75 GPA and an ACT of 29 or SAT of 1330. We found no class requirement on the program's page; ask your counselor to be sure.

infoCards.title: Ned McWherter Scholars Program
infoCards.text: A competitive award for students with at least a 3.75 unweighted GPA and an ACT of 32 or SAT of 1430.

infoCards.title: Middle College Scholarship
infoCards.text: For students with at least a 3.0 GPA at the end of 10th grade who attend a middle college full time from 11th grade.

infoCards.title: Tennessee Promise
infoCards.text: Tennessee Promise has no GPA, test or class requirement to start. Apply by November 2 of 12th grade, file the FAFSA by April 1, and do community service each year.
